**Chinese name:** 上海艾为电子技术股份有限公司 (Àiwéi)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The archetypal volume-first Chinese consumer-analog house — where import substitution is done and the fight is now price: FY2025 revenue ¥28.54亿 (-2.7%) with profit +24% on mix, then H1 2026 non-recurring profit down 91% as memory-driven smartphone cost inflation hit customers. Its ¥1.9 billion January 2026 convertible is earmarked for the auto/industrial escape.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Audio/haptic/PMIC/RF analog for smartphones, wearables, robotics and increasingly automotive.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2008 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Smartphone/IOE analog portfolio — audio amps, haptics, PMIC (charge pump/backlight/AMOLED), RF switches/LNA, LED/motor drivers |
| **Node Sophistication** | Mature BCD/analog nodes; no advanced-node dependency |
| **Entity List** | No |
